description: This file defines API endpoints for scenario analysis within a simulation engine, using an AgentRouter for handling reasoning tasks. It includes functions for decomposing a scenario into analytical components and generating a factor graph of relevant attributes, with detailed prompts and analyses for each.

methods.name: ScenarioAnalysis decompose_scenario( scenario: str, context: List[str] = [] )
methods.description: Performs detailed analysis of a given scenario string, returning structured insights including entity type, decision type, options, and in-depth analysis, using an AI-powered reasoning process.

methods.name: FactorGraph generate_factor_graph( scenario: str, scenario_analysis: ScenarioAnalysis, context: List[str] = [] )
methods.description: Creates a factor graph representing relevant attributes of entities based on the prior scenario analysis, detailing attributes, their relationships, and sampling strategies for simulation.

ctags.name: generate_factor_graph
ctags.signature: ( scenario: str, scenario_analysis: ScenarioAnalysis, context: List[str] = [] )
